title: Siamese Transformer on MRI predicts response to rectal cancer chemoradiotherapy
summary: A transformer-based Siamese multimodal model combined PyRadiomics features and Med3D-pretrained ResNet101 features from pre- and post-treatment MRI in 440 patients with locally advanced rectal cancer from three centers. In the independent validation cohort it reached an AUC of 0.789, above early-fusion machine learning (0.629) and single-timepoint transformers (0.739 and 0.728). The study is retrospective, AUC is moderate and the validation cohort size was not visible in the abstract.
ai_technology: Transformer-based Siamese multimodal framework using PyRadiomics and ResNet101 deep features
organization: Second Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine

evidence.tested: Independent validation cohort from three centers, with decision curve and calibration analyses.
evidence.unknown: Validation cohort size and prospective performance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Integrates pre- and post-treatment MRI features to predict pathological complete response.
